ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Hands In The Grease
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Mine your first piece of scrap. The yard has officially claimed you.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Rust Whisperer
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Collect 50 iron scrap. You and rust are on a first-name basis now.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Wrench Wrangler
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft your first wrench. The single most important tool. Earl approves.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Sparky
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: You built a generator. The yard has power. Don't blow it.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Circuit Breaker
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Collect 10 circuit boards. You have a problem. A fun problem.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Scrap Hoarder
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Fill your inventory to at least 80%. Some people call it hoarding. You call it planning.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Night Shift
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Mine 5 blocks after dark. The yard feels different at night. Spookier.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Junior Engineer
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft 5 different things. You are no longer completely useless.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Not Alone Anymore
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Build your first ScrapBot. Your robot buddy has opinions. So does Earl.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Zero To Oh-No
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft the Go-Kart. Earl didn't set a speed limit. On purpose.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Fire Starter
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft a Blowtorch. With great power comes great responsibility. And singed eyebrows.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Can You Hear Me Now
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Build the Radio Beacon. Earl can hear you. He's pretending he can't.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Spring Chicken
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft Spring Boots. BOING. The only review they need.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Senior Engineer
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft 10 different things. Earl is reconsidering his retirement timeline.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: OSHA Nightmare
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Build the Pipe Cannon. OSHA would like a word. Several words, actually.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Arm Day
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft 4 Robot Arms. For what purpose? Only you know. Probably robots.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: King of the Yard
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Complete all 5 of Earl's quests. The yard bows to you. Earl does not. But still.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: 100 Blocks Down
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Mine 100 blocks total. The yard is starting to look different. That might be your fault.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Speed Round
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft 3 items within 60 seconds. Efficiency! Earl clocked you. Secretly impressed.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Earl Was Wrong
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Build the Flying Machine. "I said it couldn't be done." — Earl, being wrong for once.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Brains of the Operation
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft a Tin Brain. The scrapyard just got its first microcontroller.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Going Wireless
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft a Spark Brain. WiFi, Bluetooth, and 240 MHz of ambition in your pocket.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: The Eye Is Open
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft a Vision Brain. The Jetson Nano sees all. Earl is suspicious of cameras.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Full Neural Stack
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft all three brains. Tin, Spark, Vision. You are the lab. Earl is reconsidering retirement.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Owl Mode
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft Night Goggles. Military surplus or novelty — either way, darkness is cancelled.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Got You Covered
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft the Grapple Hook. Doubles your reach. Also looks extremely cool.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: It's Alive!
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Run your first tile program. The scrapyard has learned to think.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Master Builder
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft 15 different things. Earl has filed paperwork. You're competition.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Mine and Refine
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Place your first block back in the world. Creation begins where destruction ends.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Game → Reality
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Export your first Wokwi diagram. Your game robot just became a real-world circuit.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Real Iron
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Flash a tile program to a real physical device. The scrapyard just jumped into your hands.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Workshop Veteran
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Flash 10 programs to real hardware. Earl called you an engineer. First time.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Supply Chain
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Complete your first Scrap Exchange trade. Earl's contact is pleased.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Scrap Broker
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Complete 10 Scrap Exchange trades. You know how to work a deal.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Hardware Hacker
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Install your first bot upgrade. The factory defaults were just suggestions.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Optimized Unit
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Install the Neural Optimizer. Your bot is now running beyond factory spec. Earl is suspicious.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: You Named It
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Give your bot a custom name. It probably had opinions about the default.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Working Relationship
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Your bot reached 25% bond. It's starting to recognize your footsteps.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Loyal Unit
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Your bot reached 75% bond. You are listed as its emergency contact.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Best Friends
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Maximum bond achieved. The bot has rewritten its core directive to just: follow you around.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Circuit Designer
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Place 16 TRACK strips in the world. Your scrapyard now has a race circuit.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Lap Record
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Bot completes a full lap of the TRACK circuit. Earl timed it with a stopwatch. From his chair.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Let There Be Light
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Place your first Floodlight. The scrapyard has never been this bright. Earl squints.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Shareable Science
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Share a tile program via URL. Your robot brain is now on the internet. Be proud.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: AI Collaborator
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Let Spark build a program for you. That's not cheating — it's engineering.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Sensor Sweep
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Use 4 different sensor types in tile programs. You are basically a scientist now.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Magnetic Personality
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft a Scrap Magnet. Scrap comes to you now. You have earned this.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Oval Office
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Bot completes a lap on the Circuit City oval track. Earl watched. He won't admit it.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Crystal Hunter
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Mine 5 Crystal Ore blocks deep in The Deep Yard. They glow, they drop shards, and Earl thinks they're suspicious.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Head in the Game
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Toggle your headlamp on for the first time. Now you can see what you're doing. Game changer.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Industrial Action
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Fire the Scrap Cannon 10 times. OSHA filed three reports. You filed none.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Navigator
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Your bot reaches a waypoint flag for the first time. That's real GPS navigation. In a scrapyard game. Earl is quietly amazed.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Deep Yard Detective
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Your bot detected crystal ore using its magnetic sensor. The Deep Yard holds its secrets — but not from your bot.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Collateral Damage
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Destroy 3+ blocks with a single Scrap Grenade. Earl was in the shed. He heard it. He chose not to look.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Package Secured
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Loot 3 supply drops before Earl notices they exist. (Earl noticed. He's pretending he didn't.)

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Lucky Strike
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Find a hidden rare item buried in scrap. The yard hides things. Sometimes good things.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Narrow Escape
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Take a hit that drops you below 15 HP and survive. Earl says the scrapyard builds character. This is what he means.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Salvage Pro
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Complete 3 Salvage Run challenges. You think in goals, work in steps, and finish what you start. Engineering mindset.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Signal Acquired
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Find 3 buried signal caches with the signal radio. RF direction-finding in a scrapyard. Same principle as search-and-rescue beacons.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Magnetic Personality II
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft Magnet Gloves. Now you pull items from 2 blocks away. Earl wants a pair. He won't ask.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Solar-Powered
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Place 3 Solar Panels in the world. Free energy from the sky. The yard has never been greener. Or cleaner.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Steam-Punk'd
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft the Steam Boiler. Pressurized heat exchangers and PIDs are now in your scrapyard. Automation level: advanced.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Drill Sergeant
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft a Pneumatic Drill. 3× speed on metal. The Deep Yard just got a lot less deep.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Full Coverage
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft the Radar Dish. Every ore vein in your minimap range is now visible. No more guessing.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Earl On Speed Dial
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft the Comm Relay. You can now reach Earl from anywhere. He's trying to decide if that's a threat.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Industrial Revolution
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Craft all 6 new devices: Magnet Gloves, Solar Panel, Steam Boiler, Pneumatic Drill, Radar Dish, and Comm Relay. The yard will never be the same. Neither will Earl.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: The Grand Transmission
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Rebuild and activate the radio tower. You took a dead scrapyard and made it speak. Earl finally told you who he is.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Signal Out
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Place your first Signal Beacon. Your bot now has a landmark to home in on. Real autonomous robots use the exact same trick.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Field Scholar
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Discover 20 different items. Your Field Guide is filling up. Earl has noticed you reading it.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Encyclopedia Scrapcraft
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Discover every item in the Field Guide. The yard has no more secrets. Earl has one. He won't say.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Variable Star
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Run a tile program that uses variables. Your bot now has memory. Earl finds this unsettling.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Bookkeeper
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Run a program tracking 3 or more different variables at once. You basically invented state management.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Data-Driven
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: Use a variable in an IF condition. That's not guessing — that's logic. Earl is taking notes.

ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.name: Tally Champion
ACHIEVEMENT_LIST.desc: A variable in your running program reaches 10 or higher. Keep counting — robots live on numbers.
